Book your tickets to witness a special collaboration between Traditional Indian String Puppetry and Indonesian Wayang Kulit. Artists from both traditions share the stage, bringing their puppet play practices into conversation.

📆12th October, 2026.  PUPPET PERFORMANCE
A joint puppet performance between Bali and India, led by Padma Shri awardee Smt. Anupama Hoskere and team, along with Padma Shri awardee Dr. I Wayan Dibia and team.

📅11-12th October, 2026.  SHADOW PUPPETRY WORKSHOP
Immersive two day workshop led by Dr. I Wayan Dibia and team.

Part of Bali in Bengaluru, by param_foundation In association with Dhaatu Puppet Museum and mandalabengaluru , Kanakapura Road.

Book tickets at bookmyshow.com

Book a stall for doll and craft sales at the 31st year celebrations of the Dhaatu Navaratra Mahotsava!

Dhaatu Navarātra Mahotsava (DNM) features one of India’s largest doll displays, with over 10,000 dolls depicting stories from the Rāmāyaṇa, Mahābhārata, Krishna Līlā & Bhāgavata, and Śiva Purāṇa. It also includes scenes from Europe, Arabia, Disneyland etc.

With a footfall of thousands of visitors from all over Bengaluru, its a great place to showcase your dolls for sale.
